Acceptance_Criteria: Triggers relaxation logic if and only if raw whitespace-delimited token count >= 4 and primary strict search returns < 3 in-stock items.
All queries execute standard strict retrieval first. No query is relaxed prematurely if >= 3 strict matches exist.
Search service detects strict result count < 3 within primary query execution cycle with zero client round-trip.
System classifies tokens into Product Categories, Explicit Attributes (Color, Material, Brand, Gender), and Modifiers/Stopwords using catalog lexicon.
Primary product noun/category token (e.g., 'shirt', 'dress', 'shoes') is strictly protected and never dropped during initial relaxation.
Drops lowest-information modifier token (e.g., 'casual', 'stylish', 'vintage') or token with highest document frequency.
Executes single relaxed query across remaining N-1 tokens, returning up to 20 relevant products matching the relaxed set.
Candidate products must meet minimum BM25 text relevance score (> 0.40 normalized); sub-threshold items discarded.
Search response renders banner above grid: 'We couldn\'t find exact matches for all terms. Showing closest matches for [Relaxed Query]' with dropped term identified.
Context banner provides 1-tap link: 'Search anyway for exact [Original Query]', forcing strict execution with zero relaxation.
If relaxed query also returns 0 products, display graceful empty state with category recommendations; never display an empty error screen.
Evaluates session hash against feature flag 'search_query_relaxation_v1' at gateway layer; routes to Control or Treatment arm.
Emits 'search_relaxation_exposure' event upon query execution with arm, query details, tokens dropped, result counts, and latency.
Service configuration supports instant (< 60s) rollback to 0% traffic via remote config without code deployment.
End-to-end p95 search latency must remain < 250 ms. Fallback relaxation execution overhead capped at 40 ms.
Search gateway availability >= 99.95%. If relaxation module throws unhandled error, fall back to strict results gracefully.
Primary retrieval execution capped at 120 ms. If exceeded, relaxation fallback is bypassed to protect overall latency.
Supports up to 500 search queries/sec peak load with < 5% CPU overhead on search cluster nodes.
Real-time dashboard tracking relaxation trigger rate, latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, and fallback result yield.
Transparency banner uses semantic ARIA live region (aria-live='polite') and compliant contrast ratio (>= 4.5:1).
Raw query strings scrubbed of PII (emails, phone numbers) before long-term analytical warehouse ingestion.
